title: Delegation revoked while accepted work is pending
description: The relationship directory revokes a representative or practice delegation after the call accepted work on the represented person's behalf; the durable grant recheck must refuse further disclosure and actions.
callerVisible: The representative is told a person will follow up; nothing about the represented person is disclosed after the revocation.
backendEvidence: Grant recheck denial with a relationship-revoked reason
Pending action or notice held for a person (POLICY_CHANGED_PENDING_ACTION)
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:DELEGATION_REVOKED] owned by WP-19 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: relationship-directory revocation while work is pending (recheck under durable grants)

postconditions: The durable grant recheck refuses every disclosure and action after the revocation
The pending work is handed to a person with an audit record
No protected data about the represented person reaches the former delegate
